When was it measured or observed?2011 / 2014 / 2022
Who or what does it apply to?Verified Yemen Findex wave points only, each with its scope, period and coverage.

Account ownership — observed waves, not an annual line

01What does this evidence establish?

The World Bank has published three observations of account ownership for Yemen: 3.7% in 2011 (accounts at financial institutions only), 6.4% in 2014 and 11.9% in the 2021 Findex wave, reported for 2022 from fieldwork conducted from 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023 that excluded areas holding about 23% of the population. The years between these waves were not observed.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

Account ownership among adults aged 15 and over in Yemen at each observed Global Findex wave (2011, 2014 and 2022), in the areas each survey covered, as published by the World Bank.

03Who or what does it apply to?

Verified Yemen Findex wave points only, each with its scope, period and coverage.

04How current is it?

The latest observation is from the 2021 Findex wave, reported by the World Bank for 2022 (Yemen fieldwork 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023); the Global Findex 2025 edition adds no newer Yemen observation. It should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable observation is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

It does not establish values for the years between waves, an average annual growth rate or the causes of the change, and it is not a 2026 value. There is no Yemen observation for 2017 or 2024.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Weighted aggregates published by the World Bank for each observed wave: 2011 and 2014 from The Little Data Book on Financial Inclusion 2015, and the 2021 wave from World Bank Data. No values are estimated for the years between waves.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
